messages:
Alex: AM async — did a quick quota sweep in eu-west-1 and reclaimed ~28 p3-equivalent slots by removing a couple stale canary pools. Full fleet resync is running (about 2h). Noted noisy spot eviction window between 13:00–15:00 UTC, so I added a temporary corridor to prefer on-demand for warmups.
Maya: Nice work. Can you drop the node IDs so I can run a drain test later? Also did you update the autoscaler policy to avoid immediate scale-down after reclaim?
Alex: Node IDs: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7, i-0b2c3d4e5f6a7b8, i-0c3d4e5f6a7b8c9. I set the cooldown to 8m and bumped the min-replicas for canary pools to 3. Command I used to list instances:
```
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:cluster,Values=redwood-canary" --region eu-west-1 --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].InstanceId'
```
Sam: FYI, I'll run the batch-scaling stress at 17:00 UTC to validate prefix/KV cache behavior. Test will try 500 concurrent warmups; estimate needing 4 temporary T4s in us-west-2 for ~6h. Can someone approve quota/budget for that window?
Maya: Approve for 4 T4s for 6h. :thumbsup:
Liam: Blocker alert — got notified that we've hit a vCPU soft limit in ap-northeast-1 (request REQ-12345 is pending support approval). If that doesn't clear, the canary spillover will fail and autoscaler will try fallback region which increases latency.
Alex: Thanks. I already filed the escalation with the cloud rep and attached REQ-12345 to the incident. If it stalls past 14:30 UTC, I'll flip the routing to prefer eu-central-1 for ap-northeast-1 traffic.
Maya: Quick Q — is the routing flip auto (policy-based) or manual? Want to coordinate with oncall so we don't surprise prod engineers.
ops-bot: routing-policy: updated preference to on-demand when recent spot-eviction-rate > 12% (applied to eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1). Change id: rp-3307.
Maya: Good, leave a note in the runbook so oncall sees it. I'll add a short blurb under 'eviction responses'.
Sam: For the 17:00 test, I'll post the k6 script and expected metrics in the thread 30m before start. Would like someone to watch the cost dashboard while I spin the T4s.
Liam: If the quota doesn't land, I can patch the test to use smaller instances (8x) but it'll make the latency profile noisier. Prefer to keep test shape if quota comes through.
Alex: TL;DR for today: reclaimed capacity in eu-west-1, tweaked cooldowns, queued escalation for ap-northeast-1 quota, scheduled batch-scaling test at 17:00 UTC. No immediate prod impact at the moment. :eyes:
Maya: I'll follow up with drain test results and update the runbook. Leaving a small note for oncall to watch ap-northeast-1 quota ticket.
Sam: Will ping 30m pre-test and paste the script. Thanks for approvals.
deploy-bot: canary-rollout: ring-2 -> stable finished, 23 pods moved, average p99 latency +2ms, no errors. Rollout id r-202303.
Liam: ack. If quota comes through, I'll help monitor the spillover routing and verify fallbacks.
Alex: Great — if we see >10% eviction during the stress, we'll abort and gather logs. Otherwise proceed. End of AM async.
